description: This file defines the CustomerPassword class, a Java entity used for handling customer password data in a web application. It includes fields for current password, new password, and password confirmation, along with validation annotations and a custom validation annotation for password matching.

classes.name: CustomerPassword
classes.description: Encapsulates customer password data with validation rules for updating passwords, implementing Serializable.

methods.name: getCurrentPassword
methods.description: Returns the current password entered by the customer.

methods.name: getPassword
methods.description: Returns the new password entered by the customer.

methods.name: getCheckPassword
methods.description: Returns the password confirmation entered by the customer.
